description: Automated dependency-update PRs for Vivarium (gap N9). Covers the pip-compile hash lockfiles, GitHub Actions (digest-pinned), and the Containerfile.* base images. Renovate NEVER auto-merges here: every bump opens a PR that must pass the full merge-blocking gate set and carry a verified-signed commit (branch protection: 8 required checks + linear history + required_signatures + enforce_admins). Activation requires enabling the Renovate GitHub App on the repo (a one-time operator action); until then this config is version-controlled but inert.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions bumps; keep them pinned to commit SHAs (supply-chain: std-supplychain — pin actions by digest, not floating tags).
Group the Containerfile base-image digest bumps. The worker base is ALSO auto-bumped on release by worker-image.yml; this catches Containerfile.server + off-release drift. Pin by digest.
Group the Python dev/runtime lockfile bumps (pip-compile --generate-hashes). Renovate re-runs pip-compile so the hashes regenerate.
Separate any major bump out of the groups so the breaking-change review is isolated (workflow-release SemVer).
